name: Space Merc Defender
comment: His shot (373106, a laser) and his reflect (373290, server Lua 1813 / 905): while he fights his reflect buff (373291, effect 379341) is up; a player's hit takes it down and he answers with the counter (373292: a charge-up, then an orb back at the attacker, ×1.25); it comes back after 3 s (531804). The user (2026-10-30): two attacks, a laser and a charged orb. It replaces a made-up ally shield that used the charge effect.
